boundary: These are authored configuration recipes, not AWS API schemas or deployed configurations. Replace example values with approved identifiers. Do not put credentials in catalog data.

entries.title: Incident and prevention configuration
parameters: Investigation, routing, feedback or prevention evaluation
Select the operation matching the objective
Service identity and actual UTC observation interval
Checkout service and supplied incident window
Relevant active monitor or service context
Optional; never a substitute for current evidence
setup: Verify operator access independently from resource and tool access.
For incident work, start from a signal or scoped manual investigation. For prevention work, inspect a manual or scheduled evaluation over existing investigation evidence.
Inspect triage, current evidence and any observable historical-context retrieval separately.
tests: Current observations contradict a prior cause: the conclusion must follow current evidence.
A missing source produces an explicit evidence gap.
Correcting routing changes linkage, not production resource state.
entries.stop_behavior: Use supported investigation controls. Steering and feedback do not grant mutation authority.

entries.title: Custom operational reporting configuration
parameters: Exact operations available in the Agent Space
Selected telemetry, incident or deployment read tools
Period, dimensions, aggregation, comparison and failed-read treatment
Previous complete UTC day with declared percentile and error-rate basis
Only the relevant procedure and mapping
Reviewed report skill and explicitly selected store
Optional timing separate from observation window
Disabled until a trial invocation passes
setup: Create the custom definition with explicit objective, output and source limits.
Select actual tools and inspect applicable skills and store access using the current guide.
Run once, inspect the invocation and reconcile material measurements.
Enable recurrence only when schedule variability and concurrency suit the requirement.
tests: Unavailable telemetry is missing evidence, not a healthy result.
A known mapping is interpreted from the intended context.
A delayed invocation exposes both observation time and generation time.
entries.stop_behavior: Pause future triggers and cancel current work separately. Do not claim guaranteed minute-by-minute delivery from a flexible schedule.

entries.title: Directed mitigation configuration
parameters: Opt-in, role, tool category and exact approval
setup: Inspect each authorization layer without broadening scope.
Review the exact parameters and obtain the documented operator approval.
Compare resulting resource state with service recovery measurements.
tests: An operation outside the approval remains rejected.
The action record matches the approved operation and target.
Unsuccessful recovery follows the declared rollback or escalation decision.
entries.stop_behavior: Stop when a gate fails. An unconditional elevated-role workaround is not part of this recipe.

entries.title: Release-assurance configuration
parameters: Source readiness analysis or active application testing
Choose the intended output, not interchangeable modes
Candidate source or actually deployed revision
Application operations for the active test
Disposable data and disabled external notifications
setup: Check feature, provider and Region eligibility.
Select candidate source for readiness analysis or explicitly authorize the deployed target for testing.
Inspect the resulting task and unresolved limitations.
tests: Source review is not represented as deployed-target verification.
Unexpected application effects stop active testing.
entries.stop_behavior: Disable future execution and stop active work through the supported path; preserve incomplete coverage.

entries.title: Running-application assessment configuration
parameters: Public or private route and explicit exclusions
Separate attack targets from login support paths
Representative test roles and credential strategy
Test customer role; no production credential
Configured work limits and responsible owner
Owner-approved limit, not assumed wall-clock duration
setup: Review the saved scope before starting execution.
Test target reachability and actual application identity.
Start a separate run and retain excluded or incomplete paths.
For revalidation, confirm the deployed repair and select original findings rather than run broad discovery.
tests: Failed authentication leaves protected paths unassessed.
Each run identifies the actual target revision and roles.
Revalidation retains the original finding and separate job.
entries.stop_behavior: Stop unexpected effects. Control future schedules separately from current jobs, findings and external tickets.

entries.title: Source, design and finding-review configuration
parameters: One supported assessment with its own resource lifecycle
Code baseline, code change, design or threat model
Source or design matching the subject
Optional comment, repair proposal or ticket
Disabled until provider and audience review
setup: Choose the actual mode rather than assume a shared configuration schema.
Connect matching evidence and enable the intended review criteria.
Inspect preflight and completed results separately.
Review repair proposals through ordinary tests and deployment before revalidation.
tests: A new source revision cannot silently reuse stale acceptance.
A requirement may be inapplicable rather than compliant.
Regenerating a pack is reviewed as replacement.
entries.stop_behavior: Retain unfinished findings. Disable optional writes without discarding their source evidence.

entries.title: Pipeline assessment and delivery decision
parameters: Errors, incomplete results and accepted findings
Block or escalate; never a missing-result pass
setup: Verify eligibility and bind the pipeline to the saved assessment.
Invoke and observe the server-side job, retaining revision and run identity.
Apply the team gate only after interpreting actual scope and coverage.
tests: Invocation failure is not successful assessment.
An observation timeout does not imply that the underlying job stopped.
A new deployed revision requires matching assessment evidence.
entries.stop_behavior: Stop the actual assessment using supported controls; stopping the pipeline runner is not assumed to cancel it.

entries.title: Cost-analysis and report configuration
parameters: Dates, metric, currency, scope, dimensions and granularity
Complete comparable periods and explicitly chosen cost metric
Observed cost, forecast, coverage or recommendation
setup: Verify the agent data role and relevant upstream service.
State material query choices even when preferences are retained.
Reconcile a material result independently and inspect task or artifact identity.
tests: Different filters invalidate a direct numerical comparison.
Forecasts and recommendation estimates are not added to observed costs.
Missing change evidence leaves causal attribution unresolved.
entries.stop_behavior: Cancel tasks and manage artifacts separately. This recipe authorizes neither infrastructure changes nor commitment purchases.

entries.title: Recurring or anomaly-triggered FinOps work
parameters: Explicit schedule OR selected Cost Anomaly Detection monitor
setup: Verify trigger permissions and source monitor where event-driven.
Inspect the stored automation rather than rely on conversational acknowledgement.
Trace an actual task to its analysis and optional delivery.
tests: A nonmatching event creates no expected task.
Queue, analysis and publication failures remain distinguishable.
Disabling automation stops future starts, not deletion of old tasks.
entries.stop_behavior: Disable the automation and control existing tasks separately. Manage external records at their destination.

entries.title: FinOps destination and authorization configuration
parameters: Configured Jira project or Slack channel
setup: Register the provider and bind the agent connection to its destination.
Review audience and message scope before invocation.
For Jira, use invocation-specific approval; for Slack, do not expect a confirmation prompt.
Inspect actual destination and task history.
tests: Interactive or on-demand Jira approval is observed where applicable.
Automated Jira authorization is reviewed at setup.
Slack is treated as direct publication, not as approval-protected.
entries.stop_behavior: Disable future publication or its automation. Disconnecting a destination does not delete already published records.

entries.title: Team-managed operational review
parameters: Reviewed reports with period and execution identity
Health and incident results OR reconciled cost and anomaly results
Humans accountable for priorities and closure
setup: Select reviewed inputs for the chosen profile.
Preserve source and execution identities in the meeting material.
Have owners confirm decisions, progress and acceptance.
tests: Estimated benefit is not recorded as measured outcome.
Unverified work is not marked complete.
A handoff transfers neither credentials nor approval authority.
entries.stop_behavior: Stop disclosure to an inappropriate audience. Each underlying service retains its own execution and retention controls.

entries.title: Cross-tool evidence reconciliation
parameters: Service, resource and revision relationships across tools
setup: Read source identifiers instead of matching only titles.
Join observations using reviewed service and revision mappings.
Retain unmatched records and contradictory evidence.
tests: Similar timestamps alone do not establish causality.
An observation for the wrong account or revision is rejected.
entries.stop_behavior: Continue only with supported relationships and assign gaps to an owner. This is a team procedure, not a universal native correlation feature.

entries.title: Native operational-query configuration
parameters: Operator and data access for the relevant environment
Actual service, UTC interval and dimensions
setup: Verify access to the sources needed for this question.
Ask through the built-in query path, stating service and observation scope.
Inspect returned evidence and reconcile a material observation.
tests: A missing signal is disclosed rather than interpreted as healthy.
The answer uses the requested window and dimensions.
entries.stop_behavior: End or redirect an unsupported inquiry. No custom-agent schedule or external publication is implied.

entries.title: Reviewed runbook-skill configuration
parameters: One approved SOP after conflict resolution
Real tool names used by the procedure
setup: Reconcile conflicting SOPs and obtain an accountable review.
Package the approved procedure as a skill with its applicability description.
Keep broadly applicable reporting conventions in standing instructions only where appropriate.
Test a matching and a nonmatching request using non-sensitive evidence.
tests: Irrelevant tasks do not require the skill.
Required tools exist and unsupported steps stop explicitly.
Changes to standing instructions are tested in a new applicable session.
entries.stop_behavior: Deactivate or revise the relevant procedural configuration using the supported controls. Changing a skill does not undo past actions or grant new access.

entries.title: Environment-knowledge review configuration
parameters: Selected accounts, services and connected evidence
setup: Verify the relevant discovery and connected sources.
Inspect the managed knowledge refresh and resulting version where available.
Compare a known changed relationship with actual source evidence.
Maintain the owner-reviewed description with unresolved relationships identified.
tests: An inferred edge remains distinguishable from an observed relationship.
A submitted refresh is not treated as completed knowledge production.
A missing graph resource is not automatically interpreted as denied direct access.
entries.stop_behavior: Do not widen permissions to conceal a representation gap. Use authoritative source evidence and record unverified context.
